sources.title: Image-to-Text Bilingual Dataset from Medical Prescriptions
license_confirmed_from: DataCite API rightsList for DOI 10.17632/tg2hm7n2bs.1: rightsIdentifier cc-by-4.0, rights "Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International", rightsUri https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode (https://api.datacite.org/dois/10.17632/tg2hm7n2bs.1, retrieved 2026-11-23)
Mendeley dataset page v1 licence.short_name "CC BY 4.0" and licence.full_name "Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International" (https://data.mendeley.com/datasets/tg2hm7n2bs/1, retrieved 2026-11-23)
notes: Version 1 contains 600 handwritten prescription images with Bangla and English annotations (published 2025-12-30). Version 2 (DOI 10.17632/tg2hm7n2bs.2, 1000 images, published 2026-01-19) exists; this importer pins version 1 as specified in the SoalTech appendix and the project brief.
Authors state that patient names and other identifying features were blacked out. Annotations are human transcriptions, not independently clinician-verified structured labels.
The v1 public file is Prescription_Dataset(600)-t4I2Mj.zip (36,425,756 bytes, sha256 bbd59fd6763f32648f5f891d87f5c222e5c7f60b014af7b90745b9093787dfe3).

sources.title: Medical Records Parsing Validation Set
license_confirmed_from: Hugging Face datasets API cardData.license=mit and tags license:mit (https://huggingface.co/api/datasets/ekacare/medical_records_parsing_validation_set, sha dbfce4dd6ed5593e7804619ab9f3b2178504bfe9, retrieved 2026-11-23)
Dataset card License section: "This dataset is released under the MIT License" (also copied at datasets/ekacare/DATASET_CARD.md)
notes: Hugging Face lists this dataset as gated (API field gated=auto). File downloads return HTTP 401 with x-error-code GatedRepo until a Hugging Face account accepts the terms. This importer does not attempt to bypass that gate.
EkaCare publishes images, prompts and evaluation rubrics, not official transcriptions or the underlying clinician-annotated structured JSON. Recorded reference_type is no_transcription.
License MIT is visible on the public dataset card and via the unauthenticated HF datasets API (cardData.license=mit, tags license:mit) even though the parquet shards themselves are gated.
HF API reports 288 test examples and download_size 24480000 bytes at sha dbfce4dd6ed5593e7804619ab9f3b2178504bfe9.
After accepting the terms, scripts/import_datasets.py ekacare (HF_TOKEN + pyarrow) can fetch shards; that script lives outside this package and is not invoked here.
sources.download_blocker: Hugging Face gated repository. Accept the terms at https://huggingface.co/datasets/ekacare/medical_records_parsing_validation_set and use scripts/import_datasets.py ekacare with HF_TOKEN if shards are needed. This importer does not bypass the gate. reference_type is no_transcription because no official transcriptions are published.
